articles.summary: Nobody we talk to switches an AI agent on overnight. Support leaders design their own on-ramp, keep supervision short, and set one question the test has to answer.
articles.title: How do support teams actually go live with an AI agent?

articles.summary: Every support leader we talk to arrives with a number for how much AI is allowed to automate. The numbers range from 30% to 90%, and what sets them is rarely the AI.
articles.title: How much of your customer service can AI actually automate?
